claim: The dataset contains 16 scored calculation tasks for 2111.01152.
The reference continuum Hamiltonian is a valley-resolved 2x2 layer Hamiltonian with bottom/top effective masses and interlayer tunneling.
The HF interaction has Hartree and Fock quadratic terms with dual-gate screened Coulomb potential.
Structured prompts perform strongest on potential definition, second quantization, interaction construction, Fock reduction, and Hartree+Fock combination in this dataset.
The analysis did not reproduce a full self-consistent phase diagram.
